newsitem.title: POLAND: Swedish Alcro-Beckers buys 32 pct of Polish firm.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Alcro-Beckers buys 32 pct of Polish firm.

text.p: Swedish paint firm Alcro-Beckers AB bought 565,550 shares, or 32 percent, of Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica SA at 89 zlotys each from National Investment Fund (NFI) No 11, the fund said on Friday.
NFI 11 sold all its shares in response to Alcro-Beckers' public tender offer last week to buy the the firm's remaining 2,029,436 shares at 89 zlotys from July 25 to August 22.
Before the tender Alcro-Beckers held a 0.3-percent stake in Polifarb Debica. @
In May the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) said it had no objections to the Swedish company's purchasing a majority stake in Polifarb.
The firm, whose 700,000-share initial public offering earlier this year at 65 zlotys each was oversubscribed, seeks a main-market listing on the Warsaw bourse.
